outOfSystem.postVisuals: Post visuals (.pa and .slide classes) render in the customer product's brand, e.g. Passalong's brown radial ground, Inter, Instrument Serif italic, orange accent. Not Post maker tokens.
outOfSystem.feedChrome: Feed frames (.feed) copy the light X, LinkedIn and Instagram chrome with system fonts. Not Post maker tokens; only the cyan focus ring on editable feed text is Post maker's.

components.name: Nav Square
components.description: Rail navigation: square line-icon buttons, cyan fill when current.
components.html: todayposted
components.css: :host{--ground:#000;--ink:#fff;--ink-2:#b9b9b9;--ink-3:#8a8a8a;--line:#2a2a2a;--raise:#111;--cyan:#00bde3;--magenta:#e6007e;--lime:#a4e600;--orange:#f09609;--purple:#a259ff;--live:var(--cyan);--ui:'Noto Sans Display','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:8px;background:#000;padding:12px;font:300 17px var(--ui)} .ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink-2)} .ds-nav .sq{width:52px;height:52px;border:1.5px solid #4a4a4a;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s} .ds-nav svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:square} .ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)} .ds-nav a:hover .sq{border-color:var(--ink)} .ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--live);outline-offset:2px} .ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--live)} .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] .sq{background:var(--live);border-color:var(--live);color:#000}

components.name: Live Tile
components.description: A post as a flat colour tile with black light type and a dot patch; flips to its first line.
components.css: :host{--ground:#000;--ink:#fff;--ink-2:#b9b9b9;--ink-3:#8a8a8a;--line:#2a2a2a;--raise:#111;--cyan:#00bde3;--magenta:#e6007e;--lime:#a4e600;--orange:#f09609;--purple:#a259ff;--live:var(--cyan);--ui:'Noto Sans Display','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-tile{position:relative;width:320px;aspect-ratio:1.75;padding:18px 20px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--magenta);color:#000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--ui);transition:transform .12s} .ds-tile .h{font:300 40px/.98 var(--ui);letter-spacing:-.03em;max-width:9ch} .ds-tile .m{font:400 14px var(--ui)} .ds-dots{position:absolute;right:16px;top:16px;width:64px;height:40px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,0,0,.28) 1.1px,transparent 1.5px) 0 0/7px 7px} .ds-tile[aria-pressed=true]::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-6px;border:2px solid var(--ink);pointer-events:none} .ds-tile:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--live);outline-offset:10px} .ds-tile:active{transform:perspective(600px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg) scale(.98)}

components.css: :host{--ground:#000;--ink:#fff;--ink-2:#b9b9b9;--ink-3:#8a8a8a;--line:#2a2a2a;--raise:#111;--cyan:#00bde3;--magenta:#e6007e;--lime:#a4e600;--orange:#f09609;--purple:#a259ff;--live:var(--cyan);--ui:'Noto Sans Display','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;font:300 17px var(--ui);color:var(--ink);background:#000;padding:12px} .ds-field input{font:300 26px var(--ui);color:var(--ink);background:#000;border:2px solid var(--ink-2);padding:12px 14px;border-radius:0} .ds-field input::placeholder{color:#5a5a5a} .ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--live);outline:0}

narrative.overview:
Post maker is a black board of flat colour fields and huge light lowercase type. The product name sits across the top so large it crops at the right edge, with the next product peeking in; today's posts sit under it as square tiles that slowly flip between the post's visual and its first line. Everything else is quiet: white and grey text on black, thin square outlines, and one cyan that marks whatever is live, chosen or next.

The density is low on purpose. A visit lasts five minutes, so the screen leads with very few, very large things: one name, a handful of tiles, one cyan button. Type does the structural work that cards, panels and shadows do elsewhere. Colour is used at full strength or not at all.

The system has two outer borders it must respect. The post visuals inside the feed previews belong to the customer's product and are drawn in that product's own brand (for Passalong: a dark brown radial ground, Inter, Instrument Serif italic, an orange accent). The feed frames around them copy the light X, LinkedIn and Instagram chrome. Neither is Post maker's look, and none of their values are tokens here.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black ground, white ink, five flat fills (cyan, magenta, lime, orange, purple).
One typeface, Noto Sans Display, in light weights and lowercase, giant at the top.
Square everything: no rounded corners anywhere in the app chrome.
Flat colour tiles with black type, a dot-matrix patch and a slow flip.
Cyan is the one colour that means "live": the current page, the main action, focus, section headings.

rules.name: The One Live Colour Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only colour that marks state: current, focused, primary, in progress. Other hues may mark meaning (lime done, orange draft, magenta over limit) but never "you are here".

rules.name: The Flat Fill Rule
rules.body: Fills are flat at full strength: no gradients, no tints, no bevels, no outlines around a coloured field. Type on a fill is always black.

rules.name: The Not Our Brand Rule
rules.body: Post visuals render in the customer product's own brand, and feed frames copy the platform's light chrome. Never pull their fonts, radii, shadows or colours into the app, and never push Post maker's into them.

rules.name: The Lowercase Voice Rule
rules.body: Names, headings, nav and buttons are lowercase. Uppercase is reserved for small status pills.

rules.name: The Crop Rule
rules.body: The pivot header is meant to run off the right edge. Do not shrink it to fit.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: No shadows on buttons, tiles, inputs, panels or the rail. If something needs to stand out, give it a fill or make it bigger.

dos: **Do** keep the ground pure black (#000000) and every fill flat at full strength, with black type on it.
**Do** use cyan for every "current", "focused" and "do this next" state, and keep one cyan block button per view.
**Do** set names, headings, nav and buttons in light lowercase Noto Sans Display.
**Do** let the pivot header crop at the right edge, with the next product showing.
**Do** keep every app shape square (0px radius).
**Do** render post visuals in the customer product's own brand, inside feed frames that copy the platform.
donts: **Don't** add gradients, bevels or tints to a fill, or outline a coloured field.
**Don't** put shadows on chrome; the only shadow is the screenshot crop inside a tile.
**Don't** round corners in the app chrome.
**Don't** use Dim Grey or Quiet Outline for small text.
**Don't** take the Passalong post look (brown ground, Inter, Instrument Serif italic, orange accent) as Post maker's style.
